## Executive Summary
Sakthivel E is a 4th-year AIML engineer focused on hands-on software development, machine learning workflows, and building production-ready products. He specializes in full-stack backend development, computer vision, local AI inference environments, database design, and organizing AI educational workshops.

## Practical Systems & Shipped Work
- **Internal Complaint Portal**: Multi-role backend engine built with Flask, SQLAlchemy, JWT Authentication, migrations, and PostgreSQL.
- **PMLNT (Personal Markdown Language Note Taker)**: Markdown note-taking platform with dark theme, cyan glow aesthetics, live preview, and secure auth.
- **MediaWeave**: Multilingual text/audio/video processing platform with Supabase backend integration.
- **Crop Disease Detection & Sensor Analytics**: Computer vision pipelines using TensorFlow image classification, and sensor data analytics using NumPy & LSTM architectures.
- **AI Workshops Leadership**: Co-organized and conducted hands-on AI workshops for school students with the AIML department team, featuring interactive prompt engineering and AI image generation labs.
